say: You're the team's slow and its opener: kite from max range and start fights with the arrow, or hold it to peel when they dive you.
more: Frost Shot means every attack slows, so anyone you can reach cannot easily walk away or walk onto you. That is your whole safety net, because the kit has no dash.
Enchanted Crystal Arrow stuns longer the farther it flies, so you can start a fight from far away for your team instead of waiting for someone else to engage.
The trade-off: an arrow spent to start a fight is an arrow you do not have when their diver reaches you. Decide which before the fight, not during it.
check: Who on their team can reach you, and whether your team is close enough to follow an arrow.
breaks: If they have several divers and nobody is peeling for you, stop opening fights; stand behind your front line and keep the arrow for whoever jumps on you.

asks: what can I do with arrow
say: Six gives you a stun that starts the fight, so all-in bot while they're still five, or fire it across the map to help another lane.
more: The arrow turns your lane from poke into a real kill threat, because a stunned target takes your full slow and damage plus your support's.
Sent to another lane it stuns longer, since the stun grows with distance travelled. That can win mid or a river fight while you keep farming.
Bot use pays now in kills and plates. Cross-map use pays in someone else's lead, but leaves your own lane without a stun until it returns.
check: Whether the lane opponents are in front of their minions with nothing to hide behind, and whether another lane has a fight the arrow can reach.
breaks: If their support can block or dodge it easily, or their jungler may be near, keep the arrow as a disengage and just trade with Volley.

asks: how do I trade as Ashe
how do I win lane as ashe
say: Poke with Volley and attacks from max range while the wave is even, or just farm and build Ranger's Focus on minions when they out-trade you.
more: Volley fires in a cone and applies your slow, so it punishes anyone standing outside their minions. A slowed target then has to take a couple more attacks walking away.
Ranger's Focus builds by attacking, so hitting the wave before a trade means the trade starts with it ready.
Long range poke adds up over a few waves and sets up an arrow kill at six. The cost is mana and a wave that pushes toward them.
check: Where their support is standing, your mana, and whether the wave is pushing you into gank range.
breaks: Against hard engage supports, do not step forward to poke; a single hook or dash kills you. Farm from range and let them come to you.

when: a dragon, herald or baron fight is coming, or their jungler has not shown recently
asks: where do I send the hawk
say: Send Hawkshot over the objective pit or their jungle entrance before you walk in, or over a lane about to be ganked if nothing is up.
more: Hawkshot can scout anywhere on the map, so you get information without anyone having to face-check. That matters most in the half minute before an objective.
Seeing their jungler lets your team choose: start the objective, fight, or back off. Without it you are guessing.
Used on a side lane instead, it warns a teammate early, but then you go to the next objective blind. Pick the one that decides more.
check: Which objective is spawning next and where their jungler was last seen on the map.
breaks: If you already have wards covering the area, hold the hawk for the moment someone disappears rather than spending it on ground you can see.

asks: what do I do in teamfights as Ashe
who do I hit as ashe
say: Hit whoever is closest and safe and keep them slowed, or arrow their carry first when your team is ready to jump on the stun.
more: Your attacks slow, and critical strikes apply a stronger slow instead of bonus damage. So your value is making their front line unable to reach your team.
Opening with the arrow on a carry can end the fight in one go, but only if teammates are in range to follow.
Holding it keeps you alive against a diver. A late-game Ashe who dies first gives up the fight and usually the objective after it.
check: Who their divers are, whether they have used their gap closers, and how close your team is to the target.
breaks: If their backline out-ranges you, do not walk forward for the carry; kite the front line back toward your team and let them overextend.

asks: what does corki want from the game
say: You farm safely early and become a long-range poke carry later, or use Valkyrie to dive in when a low target is alone.
more: Missile Barrage stores missiles over time, so you can chip people down before a fight from far away. That is your mid and late game.
Your attacks deal part of their damage as true damage and Gatling Gun reduces armor and magic resist, so you also hurt tanks at close range.
The trade-off is that Valkyrie is both your escape and your engage. Flying in to finish someone leaves you with no way out.
check: How many missiles you have stored, and whether anyone on their team can lock you down once Valkyrie is used.
breaks: If you are behind or they have heavy crowd control, stay at missile range and never use Valkyrie forward; it is only your exit.

say: Six unlocks Missile Barrage, so start poking them off the wave with stored missiles, or shove the wave first and poke under their tower.
more: Missiles build up over time to a maximum, so arriving at a fight or a lane with a full stock is much stronger than arriving empty.
Before six you are mostly farming with Phosphorus Bomb. After six you threaten health bars from outside their range, which wins you priority.
Each completed item makes the missiles hit harder, so your pressure keeps growing through the mid game rather than peaking early.
check: Your stored missile count, your mana, and whether minions are blocking the line to them.
breaks: If you are low on mana, save missiles for the wave and the next objective fight instead of spending them on poke that does not kill.

asks: how do I lane as Corki
how do I trade early on corki
can I fight early as corki
say: Farm with Phosphorus Bomb and take short trades when they step up, or give the push and last-hit under tower against stronger early laners.
more: Phosphorus Bomb hits an area and reveals what it lands on, so it clears waves and checks a bush in one cast.
A close trade with Gatling Gun running shreds their resistances and your attacks add true damage, but you have to stand near them to do it.
Giving early priority costs a little farm now. It keeps Valkyrie available, which is what saves you from the first gank.
check: Whether Valkyrie is available, and where their jungler could be for the first few minutes.
breaks: If their laner has kill pressure at close range, do not walk up for Gatling Gun trades; stay at bomb range until you have missiles.

when: dragon, herald or baron is spawning within a minute
asks: what do I do before dragon as Corki
how do I set up objectives on corki
should I poke before the fight
say: Get there early with full missiles and poke them down before it starts, or clear mid first if they'd win a straight fight.
more: A team that is chipped to half health cannot contest, so your poke decides the objective before anyone engages.
Phosphorus Bomb reveals the area it hits, which helps check the pit or a bush without walking into it.
Showing up early costs a mid wave. Shoving first keeps your gold and tower safe, but gives them the first positions around the pit.
check: Stored missiles, your mana, and whether your team has vision around the pit.
breaks: If they have hard engage that reaches you at missile range, stand further back and poke only the front line; do not trade your life for chip damage.

asks: what do I do in fights as Corki
who do I hit as corki
say: Poke with missiles until someone is low, then attack the nearest target, or fly in with Valkyrie only when their crowd control is already used.
more: Your damage comes in two parts: missiles before the fight, then attacks and Gatling Gun during it. Skipping the first part wastes half your kit.
Gatling Gun lowers armor and magic resist for everyone it hits, so standing near your team's main target helps all of their damage too.
Valkyrie forward ends a fight fast when it works. When it fails you are the carry who died first.
check: Which of their stuns and dashes are gone, and how much health the front line has left after your poke.
breaks: If nobody got low from poke, do not force the fight; keep poking or back off and wait for missiles to restock.

say: You trade in short bursts, heal back for free, and execute low targets, or push a side lane when they have too much kiting.
more: Perseverance regenerates your health whenever you have not been hit recently, so every trade you walk away from heals back while theirs does not.
Decisive Strike gives speed, breaks slows and silences, Judgment does the damage, and Demacian Justice finishes anyone low.
You have no dash and no ranged ability. Teams that can kite you make fights hard, which is when a side lane is the better use of you.
check: Whether their team has slows, dashes and range to keep you off them, or whether you can simply walk at someone.
breaks: If you cannot reach anyone in fights, stop running at the backline; guard your own carry and silence whoever dives them.

asks: how do I trade as Garen
how do I win lane as garen
when do I go in on them
say: Run in with Decisive Strike, spin, then walk out and heal up, or stay back and regenerate if they have just used abilities on you.
more: The silence stops them answering during the spin, so a short trade is mostly one-sided. Leaving straight after is what keeps it that way.
Your passive only works while you have not been hit, so against ranged laners a few seconds of standing back is worth more than a forced trade.
Repeating this over several waves sets up the level six execute. Long extended fights are what most opponents want from you instead.
check: Their health after each trade, and whether the wave is big enough that their minions punish you for walking in.
breaks: Into a ranged opponent who pokes you every time the passive starts, give up some farm and trade only when they step inside your speed boost range.

asks: is six a kill on garen
can I kill them with ult
say: At six, a normal trade plus Demacian Justice kills from surprisingly high health, so look for it now, or save it for their jungler's gank.
more: The execute means you no longer need to win a long fight. You need one good trade, then a second one that ends with the ultimate.
Held instead, it turns a two-on-one into a kill on whichever of them is lower, which often stops the gank cold.
Your first completed item makes the spin hit much harder, and from then on most laners cannot stand in it.
check: Their health bar before you start, and whether they have an escape or a summoner spell to get out of the silence.
breaks: If they are level six with a stronger ultimate and full health, do not open the fight; trade short first and only commit when they are low enough.

when: after 14:00 and no objective is spawning within a minute
asks: do I group or side lane as garen
where do I go as garen
say: Push the side lane away from the next objective and make someone answer you, or group when your team needs a front line to fight.
more: You heal between waves for free and clear fast with Judgment, so you can stay in a side lane a long time without going back.
Courage builds armor and magic resist as you kill units, so farming a side lane also makes you tankier for later.
If one enemy comes, you duel them. If two come, your team has a numbers edge at the objective. Either answer is fine, as long as you live.
check: How many enemies are missing from the map, and whether you could survive if two of them appear.
breaks: If their team can start a four-on-four and win it without you, group instead; a side lane only works while your team can stall.

asks: what do I do in teamfights as Garen
do I go for the carry
say: Silence and spin on whoever you can actually reach and save the execute for a carry, or stand by your own carry against divers.
more: Decisive Strike breaks slows on you and silences the target, which shuts down an assassin or mage for the moment that matters.
The execute is best on their most dangerous champion once they are low, not on a tank who was dying anyway.
Running at the backline can win the fight or leave your team without a front line. Peeling is slower but far more reliable.
check: Whether their carries have dashes or flashes left, and who is threatening your own carry.
breaks: If you get kited and never arrive, change target; hit the nearest enemy with your team rather than chasing alone.

say: You bully lane early with cannon poke and hammer all-ins, so build a lead before fifteen, or poke for your team if lane stays even.
more: You have two stances with separate abilities, so you can poke at range in cannon and then leap in with the hammer when they are low.
That flexibility is strongest early, while other champions are still missing levels and items. Your job is to turn it into plates, farm and tower gold.
Later you are fragile in the middle of a fight. Without a lead, your role shrinks to chipping people down before fights begin.
check: Whether you are ahead in CS and level, and how tanky their team is getting.
breaks: If you are behind, stop looking for hammer all-ins; stay in cannon, poke from the back and take side waves safely.

asks: how do I trade as Jayce
how do I win lane as jayce
say: Poke in cannon until they're hurt, then leap in with the hammer to finish, or knock them away with Thundering Blow if the trade turns.
more: Swapping to cannon makes your first attack reduce their armor and magic resist, and swapping at all gives a burst of speed for spacing.
To the Skies leaps and slows, Lightning Field damages around you, and Thundering Blow knocks them back, which either ends the trade or saves you.
Hammer stance restores mana per strike, so hitting minions in hammer between trades lets you keep poking far longer.
check: Their health, your mana, and whether a big enemy wave will punish a leap into melee.
breaks: If their champion wins every melee exchange, never leap first; stay in cannon and use the hammer only to knock them off you.

asks: when do I fight as jayce
say: Your R is just the weapon swap, so six adds no new ultimate; press now while they lack theirs, or play safer once they hit six.
more: Most laners get a big new ability at six. You do not, which means your strongest window is the early levels before that.
Your real spikes are completed items, since your poke and all-in both grow with attack damage.
Use the early window for a CS lead and tower plates. That gold is what keeps you relevant when their ultimates come online.
check: The enemy laner's level, and whether their level six ultimate can kill you in one rotation.
breaks: If they hit six first and have kill pressure, stop walking up; farm at cannon range until your next item is finished.

asks: what do I do in fights as Jayce
do I go in as jayce
how do I poke before a fight
say: Poke from the back in cannon before the fight starts, or drop Acceleration Gate so your team can run in when someone is caught.
more: Acceleration Gate speeds up every ally who passes through it, so it is an engage tool for your team and an escape when the fight goes badly.
Hammer stance is for cleaning up low targets or knocking a diver off your carry with Thundering Blow.
Going in early as Jayce usually means dying early. Chipping first means the fight starts with them already hurt.
check: How low their front line is after poke, and who can jump on you if you step forward.
breaks: If their team engages from long range before you can poke, switch to protecting your carry with the knockback instead of looking for damage.

when: you are ahead of your lane opponent in level and CS
asks: I'm ahead as Jayce what now
how do I use my lead on jayce
what do I do with a lead
say: Take the tower while you're ahead and then pressure a side lane, or bring your lead to the next objective and poke them off it.
more: Your lead is worth the most right now, because your kit does not scale as hard as theirs. Every minute spent idle gives it back.
Cannon stance lets you hit towers from range and Acceleration Gate gets you out when someone comes to stop you.
A side lane forces them to send people. An objective uses your poke directly. Choose whichever one is actually available in the next minute.
check: Which objective is spawning next and how many of their team are showing on the map.
breaks: If you start getting caught in the side lane, stop going past the river alone; stay with your team and poke instead.

say: You scale by completing Hunts, so plan your path around your marks, or just farm and gank safely when a mark is too risky.
more: Each completed Hunt permanently strengthens your basic abilities, and every four also add attack range. Marks are your second source of gold.
You are a ranged carry in the jungle: Dance of Arrows for moving, Mounting Dread for the slow and the big third hit, Wolf's Frenzy for healing.
Lamb's Respite stops anything inside dying for a moment, which wins fights when timed well and saves enemies when timed badly.
check: Where your current marks are, and which enemies are near them.
breaks: If you are behind and every mark is deep in enemy territory, ignore them; full clear your own camps and take marks only with a teammate close.

asks: how do I clear as Kindred
where do I start as kindred
full clear or gank as kindred
say: Full clear toward the side with your mark, staying inside Wolf's Frenzy and tumbling between attacks, or stop at three camps for an overextended lane.
more: You clear at range, so you take little damage if you keep moving, and Wolf's Frenzy charges a healing attack as you move and attack.
Finishing all six camps gets you about level four as the first crabs spawn at 2:55, which is when early marks start to matter.
An early gank can also complete a champion Hunt, which is worth more than a camp. It costs clear tempo if it fails.
check: Where your mark is, your health after the clear, and which lanes are pushed toward your side.
breaks: If their jungler is a strong early duelist and may invade, path away from them and finish your clear on the safe side instead.

when: you have a Hunt marked on an enemy laner
asks: do I go for the marked champion
who do I gank as kindred
say: Gank the lane with your marked champion if they're pushed up, since a kill completes the Hunt, or farm nearby and wait for a better wave.
more: A takedown on a marked champion counts as a Hunt, so that gank pays twice: the kill and a permanent upgrade.
Mounting Dread slows first, and the third attack on that target hits very hard, so you need them far enough from tower to land three attacks.
Forcing a bad gank for the mark costs camps. Clearing nearby keeps your farm and leaves the mark available when the lane pushes.
check: Whether that laner is past the middle of the lane, their escape abilities, and whether your laner has health to help.
breaks: If the marked champion is safe under tower, choose a different lane rather than waiting around for it.

when: their jungler just showed on the opposite side of the map or is dead
asks: should I take the mark in their jungle
do I invade for my mark
is it safe to go for the mark
say: If a mark is on their side, take it now while their jungler is away, or clear your own camps if lanes can't help.
more: Marks give you a reason to cross the river that other junglers do not have, and a completed Hunt is permanent.
The risk is the same as any invade: you are a fragile ranged champion in a place where their laners arrive first.
Taking it also removes one of their camps, which sets their jungler behind. Skipping it keeps your own clear on time.
check: Where the mark actually is, and whether your nearest lanes have priority to move first.
breaks: If the nearest enemy laners are pushing and could collapse, leave the mark; it is not worth dying for.

asks: how many marks do I need
am I strong yet as kindred
say: Every fourth Hunt adds range and that's your real spike, so fight harder after each one, or farm to your next item if marks are slow.
more: Range is what lets a marksman hit without being hit, so the fourth Hunt changes which fights you can take.
Level six matters too: Lamb's Respite lets you take a fight that would otherwise kill you, or stop an ally from dying on a dive.
Marks and items stack together. Behind on marks, lean on farm and items. Ahead on marks, force fights around objectives.
check: How many Hunts you have completed, and how your items compare with their carries.
breaks: If you are short on both marks and items, avoid open fights and play around a teammate who can protect you.

asks: what do I do in fights as Kindred
when do I use kindred ult
say: Play like a marksman from the back and drop Lamb's Respite on whoever is about to die, or hold it if enemies would be saved too.
more: Nothing inside the zone can die until it ends, and that includes enemies. Placed carelessly it rescues the target your team just killed.
Best use is on your own carry or yourself when their burst lands, so the damage is wasted and you are healed at the end.
It also works around objectives, where a low ally would otherwise die, but watch that the enemy is not standing inside as well.
check: Who is standing inside the zone area, and whether the enemy inside it is low.
breaks: If their low champions would be inside it, do not cast; tumble away and keep attacking instead.

say: You're the engage and the front line: start fights with Twisted Advance or the big root wall, or peel your carry when they dive first.
more: Twisted Advance makes you untargetable while you dash and roots the target on arrival, so it is a guaranteed start on one person.
Nature's Grasp is a wide wall that moves forward and roots everything it reaches, which is how you start or stop a five-on-five.
You do little damage yourself. Your game is good only if teammates are close enough to use what you lock down.
check: Where your damage dealers are standing before you go in.
breaks: If your team is behind and cannot follow, stop engaging; save the root and the knockback of Bramble Smash for protecting your carry.

asks: how do I clear as Maokai
full clear or gank as maokai
say: Full clear toward the lane you want to gank, using your healing attack between spells, or gank at level three if a lane is pushed up.
more: Sap Magic heals you on an attack and comes back faster each time you cast, so weaving attacks between abilities keeps you healthy through the clear.
A full clear is about level four as the first crabs spawn at 2:55, which gives you all three basic abilities for the gank after.
An early gank works because the root cannot be dodged by walking. It costs you camps, and you fall behind if nothing comes of it.
check: Your health after each camp and which lanes are pushed toward your side.
breaks: If their jungler invades you early, you will not win the duel alone; give the camp and clear the other side.

asks: who do I gank as Maokai
how do I gank as maokai
say: Gank lanes with damage, since your root holds them but won't kill them, or keep farming if your laner is low or out of mana.
more: Twisted Advance is point and click, so the gank succeeds if you get in range. Follow with Bramble Smash to slow them for your laner.
Throw a sapling ahead to slow their escape route. Saplings are more effective placed in brush.
A lane with crowd control of its own chains with yours. A lane with no damage just wastes both your time and theirs.
check: Your laner's health and mana, and whether the enemy still has a dash or flash to get out of range.
breaks: If they flash before you reach them, do not dive after them; shove the wave with your laner and go back to camps.

when: dragon, herald or baron is spawning within a minute
asks: how do I use saplings for objectives
what do I do before dragon as maokai
say: Throw saplings into the brush on their path to the pit before it spawns, or stack them at the pit entrance if you're late.
more: Saplings stand guard where they land and are more effective in brush, so they warn you and hurt whoever walks in first.
That lets your team hold the river without anyone face-checking, which is how most picks before an objective happen.
Saplings on their approach buy warning. Saplings at the pit protect the take. You rarely have mana for both.
check: Which side their team is likely to approach from and how much mana you have left for the fight.
breaks: If you are low on mana, stop throwing saplings and keep enough for Twisted Advance and the ultimate.

asks: what do I do in fights as Maokai
when do I ult as maokai
say: Send Nature's Grasp down a choke to start the fight and dive whoever it roots, or hold it to stop their engage on your carry.
more: The wall moves slowly, so it lands best in narrow places like river entrances and jungle paths where they cannot step around it.
Used forward it sets up a wipe. Used backward it roots everyone chasing your team and turns a lost fight into an even one.
Twisted Advance is your follow-up either way: untargetable on the way in, then a root on the most important target in reach.
check: How narrow the ground is where they are standing, and whether your team is ready to follow.
breaks: In open ground where they will just sidestep the wall, keep it and wait for a choke or for their dive.

say: You farm to six, then use Paranoia to dive whoever is alone or overextended, or keep farming and take the objective if nobody is.
more: Paranoia cuts every enemy's sight and removes their shared vision, then launches you onto a nearby champion. It is a gank from where they cannot see.
Before six you are a normal melee jungler with a healthy clear, since Umbra Blades hits around you and heals.
Each ultimate should buy a kill, a tower or an objective. Using it just to arrive somewhere leaves you waiting for the next one.
check: Which enemies are far from their tower and low enough to finish.
breaks: If their team groups early and stands together, stop diving alone; use Paranoia to follow your team's engage instead.

asks: how do I clear as Nocturne
full clear or gank as nocturne
say: Full clear all six camps and reach six fast, since your ultimate is your gank, or gank at three only if a lane is badly overextended.
more: Umbra Blades damages everything around you and heals, and attacking brings it back sooner, so multi-monster camps go quickly and you stay healthy.
Fight camps on your Dusk Trail: it gives you speed and attack damage while you stand on it.
Without Paranoia your gank is just walking in and hoping the fear lands. Farming first means your ganks start when they are hardest to escape.
check: Your health after the clear and whether any lane is pushed up without an escape.
breaks: If their jungler is ganking a lot and your lanes are losing, give up one camp to hover the lane that is in trouble.

asks: I just hit six on nocturne
say: Six is your spike: ult the pushed-up lane with the least escape right now, or hold it for the next dragon or herald fight.
more: The first Paranoia often comes before the enemy has adjusted, so it is the easiest kill you will get all game.
A kill in a side lane turns into plates or the nearby objective. Holding it means you arrive at the objective with your engage ready.
If you hit six before their jungler does, that is also a window to fight them or take their camps.
check: Enemy laner levels and health, which lanes are pushed toward your towers, and the enemy jungler's level compared with yours.
breaks: If every lane is under their own tower, do not force a dive; clear camps and wait for someone to walk forward.

asks: who do I ult as Nocturne
how do I gank with paranoia
say: Pick the target furthest from their tower, land Duskbringer first for the speed, or wait a wave if they're standing next to their support.
more: A champion hit by Duskbringer leaves a trail too, so you keep the speed and extra attack damage while chasing them.
Unspeakable Horror only fears if they stay in range until it finishes, so stick to them rather than casting it and backing off.
Squishy carries and mages without a dash are the best targets. Tanks and champions with a long stun are the worst.
check: Whether the target has an escape or flash, and who else could arrive before you finish.
breaks: If the target has a point-and-click stun or a teammate who does, ult after that ability is used, or pick someone else.

asks: what do I do in fights as Nocturne
when do I ult in a fight
say: Wait for your team to start, then ult onto their backline carry, or use the darkness to stop them seeing your team's flank.
more: Paranoia removes their shared vision, so even when you do not jump, their team loses track of everyone they are not standing beside.
Going first usually means you take every stun they have. Going second means the carry is alone with you.
If you are ahead you can kill a carry and get out. If you are even, you are trading yourself for them, which is still often worth it.
check: Whether their main crowd control has been used, and where their carry is standing relative to the tanks.
breaks: If their carry is well protected, hit whoever dives your own backline instead; a kill on the wrong target beats dying on the right one.

say: You make one strong ally very hard to kill and turn their engage against them, or play for picks with Handshake when fights are slow.
more: Bailout delays an ally's death and saves them fully if they get a takedown, so it rewards carries who keep fighting when low.
Hostile Takeover sends enemies berserk, which turns their dive into chaos among themselves.
You are slow and easy to catch. Your power is in reacting to what they do, so stand behind someone and let the fight come to you.
check: Which ally is your team's main damage dealer and how the enemy plans to reach them.
breaks: If your carry is far behind, put Bailout on whoever is actually doing damage, even if that is not your lane partner.

asks: how do I lane as Renata
how do I trade in lane as renata
when do I throw the hook
say: Attack to mark them so your carry's hit does extra, and shield with Loyalty Program, or hold Handshake to throw off whoever engages on you.
more: Leverage marks enemies you attack, and an ally damaging the mark deals bonus damage. Short trades of one attack each add up quickly.
Loyalty Program shields allies it passes and damages and slows enemies it hits, so one cast covers both halves of a trade.
Handshake roots and can throw the target. Used forward it starts a kill. Kept back it peels an engage support off your carry.
check: Where the enemy support is standing and whether your carry is in range to hit a marked target.
breaks: Against hard engage, do not walk up to attack; stay level with your carry and keep Handshake for their dive.

asks: what does renata ult do for us
say: Six gives you Hostile Takeover, which wins grouped fights, so look to fight at the next dragon, or keep it to punish a tower dive.
more: The ultimate matters most when enemies are bunched up: narrow river entrances, objective pits and dives under your tower.
That shifts your plan from lane trades to objective fights. Arriving first and holding a choke is worth more than a little lane pressure.
Level three matters too, once Bailout, Handshake and Loyalty Program are all available for a two-on-two.
check: How tightly their team groups when they walk into the river, and when the next objective spawns.
breaks: If they fight spread out, do not wait for a perfect ultimate; use it on the two who are diving your carry.

asks: what do I do in fights as Renata
when do I use renata ult
say: Stay beside your carry, Bailout them as they drop low, and answer their engage with Hostile Takeover, or open with it down a choke.
more: Bailout only fully saves someone who gets a takedown in time, so it belongs on an ally who is still dealing damage, not one who is running.
Answering their engage with the ultimate is safest: they are already committed and grouped.
Opening with it can win the fight before it starts, but if it misses you have nothing left for their dive.
check: Whether your carry can get a takedown while low, and how grouped their team is.
breaks: If your carry gets burst before you can react, cast Bailout earlier, as the fight starts, rather than waiting for low health.

when: your jungler is alive and at least level 4
say: Bailout makes dives safer, so put it on whoever takes the tower shots and go when the wave is big, or just take plates instead.
more: The ally under Bailout has their death delayed and is saved by a takedown, so the person tanking the tower can finish the kill and live.
Handshake can root the target and throw them out from under the tower toward your team.
A dive wins the lane outright when it works. Plates are slower but cannot go wrong, and the enemy jungler showing up changes nothing.
check: Their health, their summoner spells, the size of your wave, and whether their jungler could be nearby.
breaks: If the wave is small or their jungler is unaccounted for, do not dive; shove, take plates and reset.

say: You win by making them chase you through poison, so drag people around a side lane, or run through their team in fights to split them.
more: Poison Trail is left behind you, so you deal damage by being followed, not by standing and fighting.
Fling throws someone over your shoulder, and if they land in Mega Adhesive they are rooted as well as slowed and grounded.
You are weak in the first levels and annoying forever after. The plan is to survive early, then cost them more time than you are worth.
check: How many of them are chasing you and whether you have an exit behind you.
breaks: If they have strong ranged damage that kills you before you reach anyone, stop running in; fling whoever comes for your carry.

asks: how do I lane as Singed
how do I trade as singed
how do I farm on singed
say: Walk past them with poison on and fling them toward your side, or just farm with the trail when they out-damage you up close.
more: Fling puts the target behind you, so used near your tower it pulls them out of position for a gank or tower shots.
The trail only hurts people who walk in it. Run in a line they have to follow or cross, then turn off the poison to save mana.
Short poison trades wear a melee laner down over several waves. Standing still and trading attacks is what they want you to do.
check: Your mana and health, and whether the enemy is ranged or melee.
breaks: Against a ranged laner who never follows you, do not chase; farm what you safely can and look to outlast them.

say: Six gives Insanity Potion for a big stat boost, so you can run them down in lane, or save it to escape their jungler.
more: The potion raises your combat stats and makes your poison apply Grievous Wounds, which cuts into healing champions hard.
With it on, a fling into Mega Adhesive followed by running around them is a real kill threat rather than just a poke.
From here you can also push waves into their tower and survive being chased, which is where your mid game starts.
check: Whether they have sustain or healing, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If they can kill you through the potion, use it only to disengage and keep farming for your first completed item.

asks: where do I go mid game as singed
say: Push the far side lane and make two of them chase you, or group when an objective fight is close and your team lacks a tank.
more: Anyone chasing you runs through poison and gets slowed and grounded by Mega Adhesive, and Noxious Slipstream speeds you up as you pass champions.
Every enemy who comes to stop you is missing from the objective. Two chasing you is a fight your team should win elsewhere.
The cost is that you are not there if it goes wrong. Dying in the side lane gives them the objective for free.
check: How many enemies are missing from the map and which objective is spawning next.
breaks: If they send one champion who beats you alone, stop splitting that lane; swap sides or join your team.

asks: what do I do in fights as Singed
do I run at the backline
say: Run through their team with the potion on and fling a carry into yours, or stay back and fling whoever dives your carries.
more: Mega Adhesive grounds enemies, which stops dashes inside it. Dropped on their divers or their escaping carry, it changes who can move.
Flinging a carry back into your team is your best single play. Flinging a tank into your team is usually your worst.
Running in splits their attention. Staying back keeps your carry alive. Choose by who on their team is the bigger threat.
check: Which of their champions rely on dashes, and who your fling would land next to.
breaks: If you get kited and burst before reaching them, stop leading the charge; follow a teammate's engage instead.

say: You bully melee laners with poison and blinds, then control the map with mushrooms, or split a side lane when fights don't suit you.
more: Toxic Shot poisons on every attack, so short trades keep doing damage after you walk away.
Blinding Dart makes an attack-reliant champion miss, which is why you beat most auto-attackers one on one.
You are fragile and short ranged in a real teamfight. Your team value is mushrooms around objectives and pressure in a side lane.
check: Whether their dangerous champions rely on attacks or on abilities.
breaks: Into ability-based champions who can jump on you, play further back and use Move Quick to keep distance instead of trading.

asks: how do I trade as Teemo
how do I win lane as teemo
say: Attack them every time they go for a minion and walk off, or hold Blinding Dart for when they jump on you.
more: The poison keeps ticking after one attack, so you win trades without standing still.
Blind used as poke adds damage. Blind kept back cancels their all-in, because their attacks miss while it lasts.
Harassing pushes your wave forward, which exposes you to ganks. You have Move Quick but no dash, so that risk is real.
check: Where the wave is, and where their jungler was last seen.
breaks: If the wave is pushing into them and you have no ward, back off to the middle of the lane rather than keep poking.

say: Six gives you mushrooms: put them in the river brush to protect yourself from ganks, or in the wave to push and roam.
more: Noxious Trap slows and damages whoever steps on it, and you store several over time. They work as wards that fight back.
Traps on the jungle entrances let you keep harassing without worrying about a gank from that side.
Traps in the wave clear it faster, which frees you to move to grubs or herald. You cannot afford both early, so pick one.
check: How many mushrooms you have stored, and which side their jungler usually comes from.
breaks: If you are being dived rather than ganked, put the mushrooms under your own tower where the fight will happen.

when: dragon, herald or baron is spawning within two minutes
asks: what do I do before objectives as Teemo
where do I shroom for baron
how do I help at objectives
say: Start placing mushrooms on their paths to the pit well before it spawns, or keep splitting the opposite lane if your team can stall.
more: Mushrooms need time to build up, since you only store a few at once. Starting early is the difference between a couple of traps and a field of them.
A team that walks through several traps arrives slowed and already damaged, which makes the fight far easier for your team.
Splitting the other side instead pulls someone away from the objective. It only works if your team does not fight four against five and lose.
check: Which side their team approaches from, and how many mushrooms you have stored.
breaks: If they bring a sweeper and clear your traps, stop feeding mushrooms into that area and place them deeper on their route.

asks: what do I do late as teemo
say: Push a side lane lined with mushrooms and leave when they come, or stand with your team and blind their main attacker.
more: Mushrooms along the lane warn you who is coming and slow them, and Move Quick gets you out before they arrive.
Standing still makes you invisible, and in brush you stay invisible while moving, so you can also wait for someone who comes alone.
Grouped, your best contribution is blinding their attack-based carry at the moment they start hitting.
check: Whether baron or elder is up, and how many enemies are missing from the map.
breaks: If baron or elder is being contested, be there; a side tower is not worth losing that fight a player short.

say: You pick one target and remove them: gank early with Vault Breaker and lock down a carry with your ult later, or peel if you're behind.
more: Cease and Desist runs a chosen enemy down and knocks them up, pushing aside anyone in the way. It gives your team one guaranteed target.
Denting Blows breaks armor and gives you attack speed, so you also hurt tanks in longer fights.
You go in and cannot easily get out. Your game depends on teammates being close enough to follow what you start.
check: Where your team is when you want to go, and which enemy is worth the ultimate.
breaks: If your team will not follow, use the ultimate on whoever dives your carry instead of going deep alone.

asks: how do I clear as Vi
full clear or gank as vi
should I gank early as vi
say: Clear toward a lane with setup and look to gank at level three, or full clear to level four if every lane is pushed away.
more: Vault Breaker closes distance and knocks back, so you threaten a kill before six, unlike junglers who need their ultimate.
Blast Shield charges over time and triggers when an ability hits, and Relentless Force hits everything behind your target, so camps go smoothly.
An early gank that works puts a lane ahead for the first objective. One that fails leaves you behind a farming jungler, so pick it carefully.
check: Which lanes are pushed toward your towers and whether those laners have health and crowd control.
breaks: If nothing is gankable after your third camp, do not wait around; finish the clear and contest the crab at 2:55.

asks: who do I gank as Vi
how do I gank as vi
say: Walk up as close as you can before releasing Vault Breaker, or let your laner use their crowd control first and punch second.
more: The charged punch carries you forward and knocks back, but it is a straight line and can be sidestepped or dashed away from.
Charging it out of sight and releasing late gives them less time to react. Following your laner's stun makes it nearly certain.
Lanes with their own stun or slow are the best choice. A lane with nothing and an enemy with a dash is usually a wasted trip.
check: Whether the enemy laner has a dash or flash, and how far up the lane they are standing.
breaks: If you miss the punch, do not chase under tower; help shove the wave and go back to your camps.

asks: who do I ult as vi
say: Six makes your ganks point and click, so ult the carry with no escape left, or save it to start the next dragon or herald fight.
more: Cease and Desist chases its target down, so a dash or flash does not save them from the knock-up.
That means lanes you could not gank before, like a mobile mid laner, are now available.
Spending it on a lane gets a kill now. Holding it guarantees your team an engage at the objective. Check which is closer in time.
check: Which enemy carries have used their summoner spells, and when the next objective spawns.
breaks: If the only target is a tank at full health, keep the ultimate; a knock-up on someone you cannot kill achieves little.

asks: what do I do in fights as Vi
who do I go on as vi
say: Ult their biggest damage dealer when your team can follow, or use it on the diver attacking your own carry if you're the only peel.
more: Your ultimate knocks aside enemies between you and the target, so it also breaks up their front line on the way through.
Going on their carry wins the fight if they die. If they survive, you are stuck in the middle of five people.
Peeling is the lower-risk use. It fits when your own carry is the reason your team wins fights.
check: Who on their team is doing the most damage, and whether your team is close enough to kill them during the knock-up.
breaks: If their carry has a way to survive your burst, change target to the next squishiest champion in reach.

say: You make one carry stronger and scale hard, so stay attached and keep them alive, or hop off briefly to trigger your heal when it's safe.
more: While attached you are untargetable to everything except turrets, so your survival depends entirely on who you are sitting on.
Feline Friendship restores health when you hit a champion with an attack or ability, then heals the next ally you attach to.
You add very little pressure early. The plan is to get through lane without giving kills and be worth much more later.
check: Which ally is strongest right now and whether it is safe to stand on your own for a second.
breaks: If your lane partner keeps dying, move to a teammate who is ahead; you are only as useful as the champion carrying you.

asks: how do I lane as Yuumi
when do I get off my adc
how do I poke as yuumi
say: Poke with Prowling Projectile from on your carry, steering it the long way around, or hop off to attack only when their engage is used.
more: The missile does bonus damage and a stronger slow if it travels long enough before hitting, so curving it around minions is worth the effort.
Hitting an enemy champion triggers your passive heal, which is your main way to keep the lane healthy.
Getting off to attack is the risky part. One stun while you are detached and you are the easiest kill in the lane.
check: Whether the enemy support still has their hook or stun, and your mana.
breaks: Against a lane that can kill your carry in one engage, stay attached and save Zoomies for the shield rather than using it to poke.

say: Six gives Final Chapter, five waves that heal allies and damage enemies, so take a longer fight now, or save it for the first dragon fight.
more: It turns a short trade into a long one that favours your side, because your carry is being healed through the whole thing.
You can still move, attach and cast Zoomies while channeling, so use it on your carry and keep shielding.
Your larger spike comes later with items, when your shields and heals on a strong carry start deciding fights.
check: Whether your carry is healthy enough to fight for the full duration, and where their jungler is.
breaks: If your carry is already low or out of position, use it to cover a retreat instead of forcing the fight.

asks: who do I sit on as Yuumi
do I stay on my adc
which champ do I attach to
say: Sit on whoever is carrying, since your Best Friend gets the strongest bonuses, or switch to a fed bruiser when your marksman is behind.
more: On your Best Friend you gain heal and shield power and give them healing on their attacks, so a champion who attacks a lot uses you best.
Zoomies passes its shield, move speed and attack speed to the ally you are on, which suits both marksmen and fighters who run at people.
Staying loyal to a weak carry wastes you. Moving early to the strong one is how you turn one teammate's lead into a win.
check: Compare your teammates' K/D/A, items and level to see who is really ahead.
breaks: If nobody is clearly ahead, stay with the marksman; their damage scales the most with what you give.

asks: what do I do in fights as Yuumi
when do I ult as yuumi
do I swap targets in fights
say: Stay on your carry and use Final Chapter as the fight starts, or jump to a front liner first if your carry is out of range.
more: The ultimate lasts five waves, so starting it early gets full value. Starting it when people are already dying gets one or two.
If the ally you are on dies, you are standing alone in the middle of the fight. Move before that happens, not after.
Slowing a diver with Prowling Projectile and speeding your carry with Zoomies is often worth more than chasing damage.
check: Your host's health, and which nearby ally you could jump to if they go down.
breaks: If your carry is caught and certain to die, jump to the nearest healthy ally early and keep the rest of the team alive.
